Name: Vanilla Plus Professions Farm Animals Compatibility
Author: JackHero06
Description:
I have been playing Stardew Valley for quite some time and have always been fascinated by the modding community that works to improve and expand the gaming experience, so I decided to make a small contribution by creating my first mod.

What this mod does is provide compatibility between the talents of Vanilla Plus Professions and some of the many mods that add new animals. In the near future, I will add support for animal-related professions.

I did this mainly because I felt that these talents were overshadowed by others that did affect other mods such as crops, flowers, etc.
At the moment, it affects mods such as Arcanian Animal Reserve, Alpacas mod, Milkable Sheep, and SVE Goose.

Downloads.Description: Compability with Syanide23's Peacocks for CP, silvermoonchan's Loons for 1.6 and NukaColaPrime's Penguins for 1.6
